UnlimitedPipe feeds

Free feeds of public records and news: SEC filings and insider trades, sanctions, rate decisions, economic data and market closes, new rules and court rulings, EU laws, drug approvals, critical vulnerabilities, disasters and solar storms, disease outbreaks, crypto, business and tech, science, and news from every region. Every item links to its source.

    Subscribe

    Every feed is RSS for any feed reader and JSON for code. Each item links to the record it comes from.

    Search and ask

    pip install unlimitedpipe, then unlimited search WORDS or unlimited ask "QUESTION", with a local model and every answer cited.

    History

    Every item goes into a monthly archive, archive/index.json, so questions about a year or a month reach back. Runs every 1h (live feeds: 15m).

    Built with UnlimitedPipe, open source: no server, no account, no tracking. Items come from public records and news, each with a link to its source; nothing here is investment, legal or medical advice.
